title: Guadalcanal
reading_hint: The tracks follow Morison's fold-out chart (vol. V, Battleship Night Action), digitised and registered on Savo Island, timed by its own time circles; the Japanese side is checked against Atago's and the 4th Destroyer Squadron's battle reports (JACAR). The chart scans are not yet an underlay. The coast is Natural Earth's 1:10m land. Hulls are to scale when zoomed in. Drag the map to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom.
